headline: Old Settlements Dropped From NDZ List
summary: The Town and Country Planning department has decided to remove old settlements from No Development Zone and No Development Area classifications. This move aims to lift restrictions on these older residential pockets.

headline: TCP to Remove Old Settlements From Restrictions
summary: The TCP is moving forward with plans to exclude old settlements from strict No Development Zone rules. Minister Rane confirmed that these areas will be relieved from past limitations.

headline: Restrictions Lifted for Old Settlement Areas
summary: Minister Rane announced that old settlements previously marked as No Development Areas will be taken out of restrictive zones. The policy change is expected to affect land use in those pockets.

headline: Fresh Cheating Case Against Gopal Naik
summary: A new cheating complaint involving Rs 1 crore has been filed against Gopal Naik. Authorities are investigating the fresh allegations.

headline: FIR Filed Against Two Anjuna Firms
summary: Police registered an FIR against two holiday firms in Anjuna for allegedly duping tourists. Investigations into the operation are currently underway.

headline: HC Notice in Louis Berger Case
summary: The High Court issued a notice to the state government and the Crime Branch regarding a plea filed by Digambar. The petition relates to the ongoing Louis Berger case.

headline: Floating Solar Project Planned in Panaji
summary: Goa is exploring the setup of its first floating solar project in the backwaters of Panaji. The initiative is part of the state's push towards renewable energy.

headline: Varca Comunidad Adopts Farming Model
summary: Following Chinchinim's success, the Varca comunidade is planning an agricultural comeback. The community aims to revive local farming using similar strategies.

headline: Marine Electricals Opens New Goa Plant
summary: Marine Electricals has inaugurated a manufacturing facility in Goa to build power train units for data centers. The plant will cater to growing technological infrastructure needs.

headline: Brazil Team to Arrive in Maharaja Style
summary: The Brazilian football team will receive a traditional 'Maharaja style' welcome upon arrival for their friendly match in India. Organizers have planned elaborate cultural arrangements for the squad.

headline: Elderly Sisters Found Dead in Goa
summary: Two elderly sisters were found dead inside their Goa home by police. Investigators noted that the women had thoughtfully left cash behind to cover their final rites.

headline: Push for Cumberjua Canal Dredging
summary: Goa's Captain of Ports is renewing efforts to dredge the Cumberjua canal to improve waterways navigation. Authorities are looking into funding and clearance options.

headline: 'Enough is Enough' Partners With NGOs
summary: The 'Enough is Enough' movement is joining forces with various NGOs across Goa to protest against unchecked development. The coalition plans joint advocacy campaigns.

headline: Congress Launches Goy Rakkhon Yatra
summary: The Congress party has kicked off the Goy Rakkhon Yatra initiative aimed at preserving Goa’s unique identity and culture. Leaders addressed supporters during the launch event.

headline: Congress Alleges BJP-AAP Alliance Deal
summary: Congress leader Viriato Fernandes has alleged a secret understanding between the BJP and AAP regarding electoral adjustments. He criticized the political dynamics behind the alleged arrangement.

headline: Family Abandons Dead Body Due to Poverty
summary: A family in Goa reportedly abandoned a deceased relative's body because they could not afford firewood for cremation. Local authorities intervened following the incident.

headline: Karan Wahi Shares Jennifer Winget Wedding Sneak Peek
summary: Actor Karan Wahi gave fans a glimpse into Jennifer Winget's wedding celebrations in Goa. Pictures and videos from the event have been circulating online.

headline: Ponda Gets 24x7 Wildlife Transit Facility
summary: A new round-the-clock wildlife transit and treatment facility has been established in Ponda. The center will handle rescue and medical needs for injured animals.

headline: Sand Erosion Worries Locals at Beaches
summary: Residents near Galgibaga and Tarir beaches have expressed concern over ongoing sand erosion. Locals are calling for prompt protection measures to prevent further damage.

headline: Traffic Jams Persist Near New Flyover
summary: Although a new flyover has been opened to the public, nearby junctions continue to face heavy traffic congestion. Commuters have reported delays during peak hours.

headline: Fake Marriage Poster Targets Goa Minister
summary: Vasco Police have launched an investigation after a fake marriage poster targeting a Goa minister surfaced in the area. Authorities are tracing the culprits responsible for the stunt.

headline: Asif Merchant Praises Goa's Glamour
summary: Asif Merchant remarked that Goa possesses an effortless and relaxed glamour that sets it apart from Mumbai. He highlighted the state's unique lifestyle appeal.

headline: Porvorim Flyover Access Points Coming Soon
summary: Authorities announced that entry and exit points for the Porvorim elevated corridor will be made operational within a week. Additional safety measures are also being implemented.

headline: Stray Cattle Disrupt Valpoi Offices
summary: Stray cattle roaming near government offices in Valpoi have been disrupting daily movement and public access. Citizens have urged local authorities to tackle the nuisance.

headline: Onion Prices Spike Across Goa
summary: Consumers across Goa are facing a sudden surge in onion prices in local markets. Traders attribute the hike to supply chain constraints.

headline: State Lacks Data on Hotels and Casinos
summary: While authorities have tallied toxic waste generation, official tracking of commercial hotels and casinos remains incomplete. Critics have raised questions over regulatory oversight.

headline: Goa CAMPA Compliance Slips
summary: Goa's compliance with CAMPA regulations has declined as designated panels have skipped mandatory meetings. The lapse has drawn administrative concern.

headline: 'Enough Is Enough' Plans Outreach Events
summary: The activist group 'Enough Is Enough' is scheduled to hold public outreach events in Margao and Mapusa. The sessions will focus on local civic and environmental issues.

headline: Pernem MLA Pledges Aid After Cremation Incident
summary: Following reports of a family struggling with funeral arrangements, the local Pernem MLA has stepped in to offer assistance. The lawmaker promised financial aid to prevent similar hardships.

headline: CM Sawant Assures Porvorim Flyover Solution
summary: Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has assured that issues concerning the Porvorim flyover access will be resolved within eight days. Inspections are currently underway to fix the bottlenecks.

headline: Konkani Prime News Broadcast
summary: Prudent Media aired its daily round-up of current events and local updates in Konkani. The broadcast covered top regional headlines of the day.

headline: Co-operative Societies Face Rs 40 Crore Fraud
summary: A massive financial fraud has surfaced across 14 co-operative societies in Goa, involving Rs 40 crore in outstanding dues. Investigations are probing the mismanagement of funds.

headline: GFP Maintains 'Goa First' Stance
summary: The Goa Forward Party is holding onto its 'Goa First' policy amidst ongoing speculation about a potential alliance rethink with AAP. Party leaders emphasized their independent regional focus.

headline: More Victims Expected in Holiday Scam
summary: Investigators believe that the number of victims affected by the recent holiday booking scam in Goa could rise. Police are encouraging additional complainants to come forward.

headline: Sattari Demands Check Dams for Water Crisis
summary: Residents in Sattari are urging authorities to construct additional check dams to counter impending water shortages. Dry spells have raised concerns over irrigation and drinking supply.

headline: Goa Embryologist Wins National Award
summary: A fertility specialist from Goa has been honored with a national young achiever award for contributions to embryology. The recognition highlights advancements in local medical science.

headline: Private Vehicles Parked in Margao Garden
summary: The parking of private vehicles inside the Margao municipal garden has sparked public criticism. Residents have questioned how cars gained entry into the recreational space.

headline: DISHA 2.0 Workshop Held for Legal Access
summary: A DISHA 2.0 workshop was organized in Goa to strengthen public access to justice and legal aid services. Stakeholders discussed ways to bridge gaps in legal literacy.

headline: South India Media Summit in Hyderabad
summary: Media professionals from across southern states are preparing to gather for the South India Media Summit in Hyderabad. The conference will discuss emerging industry trends.

headline: Alzheimer’s Concerns Rise Among Elderly
summary: Health experts note that Alzheimer’s disease is casting a growing shadow over Goa's aging demographic. There is an increasing demand for specialized geriatric care facilities.

headline: AAP Demands PWD Minister's Resignation
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has called for the resignation of the PWD Minister over flawed planning surrounding the Porvorim flyover. AAP leaders staged protests demanding accountability.

headline: Worker Exodus Disrupts Mapusa Garbage Collection
summary: A mass departure of workers traveling home for the Chaturthi festival has left garbage collection in Mapusa severely disrupted. Municipal authorities are trying to manage backlogs with remaining staff.

headline: Authorities Inspect Porvorim Flyover
summary: Following widespread criticism from commuters and politicians, officials conducted an on-site inspection of the Porvorim flyover. The PWD minister promised quick corrective actions.

headline: Congress Open to Alliance With GFP
summary: The Congress party has kept its doors open for a political realignment with Kejriwal's Goa ally, the Goa Forward Party. Discussions regarding future electoral strategies are ongoing.

headline: Govt to Open Porvorim Flyover Access Points
summary: The state government announced plans to open new access points and install safety barriers along the Porvorim flyover. The measures aim to ease traffic flow and enhance safety.

headline: Asian Polar Science Forum Meets in Kochi
summary: Researchers and delegates gathered in Kochi for the Asian polar science forum to discuss preparations for the Fifth International Polar Year. Scientific collaborations were a key focus.

headline: Statewide Coastal Clean-Up Clears 2.7 Tonnes of Litter
summary: Volunteers and authorities collected 2.7 tonnes of garbage during a massive coastal clean-up drive across Goa. The initiative targeted marine debris on local beaches.

headline: CoP Seeks IWAI Funds for Cumbharjua Canal
summary: The Captain of Ports is approaching the Inland Waterways Authority of India to secure funding for dredging the Cumbharjua canal. The project seeks to boost cargo and passenger transit.

headline: IIM-Nagpur Experts Inspect Porvorim Corridor
summary: Experts from IIM-Nagpur visited Goa to inspect the design and traffic management of the Porvorim elevated corridor. Their assessment will guide corrective engineering measures.

headline: Friction in BJP-MGP Alliance Over Remarks
summary: Tensions have surfaced in the alliance between the BJP and MGP after Sudin Dhavalikar publicly objected to recent remarks made by the Chief Minister. The fallout highlights strains within the coalition.
